detail.longDescription: I am a Computer Science student working on a project that analyzes dog barks to determine the underlying emotion. Aside from the complex data collection process (recording barks and their associated emotional context), the project itself involves a standard model-training workflow (I’m still in the early stages, so the exact implementation is yet to be determined). I’ve been considering adding an initial model to identify the dog's breed, which would then pass the data to the emotion-analysis model. I’m not sure if this approach makes sense or is even necessary—while there is certainly a difference between the barks of a small dog and those of a large, powerful one, it ultimately depends on how the model processes the bark itself. If anyone has any helpful information, models to share, or knows of similar projects, I would love to hear about it! :)
